sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stress Resistance is a Physical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Stress resistance improves the chances of withstanding injury shock, shaking hands, and tremors.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Level 10 of this skill is needed for the story chapter Batya

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Reduces pain shock chance (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Reduces tremor oscillation (1.2% per level → -60% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Berserk mode access

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- 0.033 points/sec for being low on health points
- 0.33 points for each "Pain" debuff
- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest Bullshit
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
- Completing the quest The Guide
- Completing the quest Night Sweep
- Completing the quest TerraGroup Employee

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text: Stress resistance can be power leveled by throwing grenades in enclosed objects like crates with an open top and staying nearby, to get consussed + the pain effect but not suffer lethal damage.
